Alexa Chung may be best known as the iconic “it girl” of the aughts, but such a broad title couldn’t adequately encompass her range. The British-born luminary has been a model, actor, television presenter, fashion editor, art director, and designer of her eponymous label. Dubbed “a phenomenon” by Anna Wintour and “the Kate Moss of the new generation,” by The New York Times, Chung is one of the most recognizable fashion personalities of our era. She was discovered at age 16 and a near-instant success story. Her stare, striking yet simultaneously warm, gives her likable appeal, making her the cool girl we want to both be and be friends with. In her expansive career, she has been featured in countless editorials and been the face of myriad campaigns for brands such as Longchamp, AG Jeans, Boucheron, Maje, and more. Chung is still a fixture in the fashion industry as a personality, designer, and one to watch.
